name: Artbreeder
summary: A collaborative tool for creating images with AI.
description: A collaborative tool for creating images with AI. Image Blending: Combines multiple images to create new artworks. Gene Editing: Adjusts specific attributes like age, gender, and mood. High-Resolution Downloads: Provides high-quality image outputs. Collaborative Creation: Allows users to work together on image projects.

pricing.label: Free
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: Image Blending: Combines multiple images to create new artworks.
Gene Editing: Adjusts specific attributes like age, gender, and mood.
High-Resolution Downloads: Provides high-quality image outputs.
Collaborative Creation: Allows users to work together on image projects.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Start Breeding
howToUse.description: Register on Artbreeder and start creating by blending images.

howToUse.title: Blend or Edit Genes
howToUse.description: Mix images or adjust gene sliders for attributes like age, gender, or style.

howToUse.title: Download or Collaborate
howToUse.description: Export your creation or collaborate with others in the community.

features_fr: Mélange d'images : combine plusieurs images pour créer de nouvelles œuvres d'art.
Édition génétique : ajuste des attributs spécifiques tels que l’âge, le sexe et l’humeur.
Téléchargements haute résolution : fournit des sorties d’images de haute qualité.
Création collaborative : permet aux utilisateurs de travailler ensemble sur des projets d'images.
